items.title: 5.6.1 Using Excel and Google Sheets for Visualization

source_refs.note: Topic 5.6.1 (PDF 148-149, printed 145-146). Short question 5 is answered.

blocks.text: Excel and Google Sheets let you enter data easily and generate bar charts, line graphs, pie charts and more. A small local business can enter each month's sales and, with a few clicks, create a bar chart to see which month had the most sales.

blocks.prompt: What is the purpose of using tools like MS Excel for data visualization (short question 5)?
blocks.explanation: They let anyone store data in a table and turn it into a clear chart in a few clicks, with no programming, so patterns such as the best sales month can be seen and shared quickly; charts update when the data change.

items: Spreadsheets: enter data, click to chart it; quick and widely available.
